title: Bob & Bob movie is now online!
author: bpatrick
body: Check it out. I think it’s amazing. Much gratitude and admiration for everyone involved. Be advised: NSFW with generous helpings of vulgar language, violence, sexual situations and full-frontal male nudity. andrewalonso.com

comments.author: Ivarian
comments.text: He did a great job adapting this into film. Really enjoyed it, glad its online and we all finally get to see it.

comments.author: Jordy
comments.text: God, this was sad. I can’t even muster any sympathy for Bob, because I hate him so much. It definitely made me think, though. The psychiatrist lady was exactly right–in some way or another, we ALL do this.
